dedupe_keys.name: drone images of wind turbine blade defects

description: The wind-turbine blade defect team publishes 1,065 visible-light drone images of real blade surfaces and matching annotations. The Scientific Data descriptor identifies six defect categories and standardized 1024 by 1024 pixel images. The Figshare deposit is one ZIP file with images, labels and benchmark split information; its metadata declares CC BY 4.0 and free public access. Coverage is the sampled turbine blades; their site locations are withheld. These labels can train or compare condition-detection models before turbine maintenance or reliability simulation. A caveat is that the operator removed turbine serial numbers and geographic coordinates under a nondisclosure agreement. The pictures therefore cannot establish site exposure, blade age or failure rate on their own. Image augmentation and benchmark splits also need careful separation to avoid leakage. The own repository metadata and the article's Data Records statement were inspected without downloading pictures or testing annotation quality. No exact related catalogue asset record was identified.
